newsitem.title: USA: General Instrument signs licensing pact.
newsitem.headline: General Instrument signs licensing pact.

text.p: General Instrument Corp on Tuesday said it signed a definitive license agreement with Pace Micro Technology Plc.
The pact covers General Instrument's MPEG 2 digital television system, including DigiCipher II access control technology.

Under the agreement, Pace will manufacture digital cable and satellite set-tops that will be compatible with the North American digital television standards and General Instrument's DigiCipher II access control system.
Specific terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
